title: Credit Policy Decision Table Builder · RBE·09
description: Browser-based credit underwriting policy authoring tool. Build decision tables (FICO × DTI × LTV → Approve/Decline/Refer), detect coverage gaps, simulate applicant profiles, generate Reg B adverse action reasons, run Champion-Challenger policy comparison, and export Policy Mandate JSON + SR 11-7 policy document. Zero PII. Client-side.
